label: Stabilize
intent: A shaky shot is locked steady. Light: the frame jitters around the fixed lock ring (1.2 units and 3 degrees, two jolts), then the ring clamps (squeezes in with a hard stop) and the frame stops dead, centred; the ring springs back open and settles. Strong: a longer, bigger shake (1.8 units and 4 degrees, four jolts), a harder clamp, and the ring settles in two beats. The frame never drifts after the clamp. The rest pose is the v1 drawing.

frame.x.//: camera shake: full-amplitude jolts, killed at once by the clamp (no natural decay)

ring.scale.//: the clamp: the ring squeezes in as the frame stops, then springs back open
